summary: grafana.grafana in Ansible 14.0.0 runs molecule only when needed and migrated stack create/update/delete to the stacks API.
questions: Does grafana.grafana use the stacks API for stacks?

answer_card.title: grafana.grafana 14.0.0 changes
answer_card.answer_md: grafana.grafana runs molecule tests only when required and **migrated Grafana Cloud stack create/update/delete to the stacks-api**.
